page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-2xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 32 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU features 32 physical cores with a single thread per core and a base speed of 2.0 GHz, operating under a shared CPU allocation model. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the server integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests, as well as Geekbench single-core metrics. It also achieves top-tier results in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. Memory bandwidth tests show strong read and write capabilities, though the Passmark memory score falls into the average category. For artificial intelligence workloads, the dual L40S GPUs and AMD EPYC processor deliver top-tier LLM inference speeds for small models, strong performance for medium models, and average performance for large 70B models.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers a high-capacity GPU and memory profile suitable for intensive parallel computing. However, users must account for the shared CPU allocation and the complete absence of local storage, which requires provisioning external block storage. The instance is highly suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, medium-scale LLM deployment, data science pipelines, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
